verdict.rationale: Gumroad documents its own public REST API covering products, sales, subscribers and licenses. It also documents OAuth + MCP access that lets an agent list sales, draft, edit and publish products, add files and cover images, and check payouts. That covers core seller workflows, but nothing claims or shows full parity with the UI, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or markdown API docs. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for storefront customization, memberships/pricing configuration, tax settings and other UI-only features; an explicit API–UI parity claim; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec; hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: public REST API for products, sales, subscribers, and licenses
OAuth + MCP so an agent can list sales, draft and edit a product, add the files and links buyers receive and a cover image, publish it, and check payouts for a connected creator
